example.content:
let received = null;
const created = eda.sys_Timer.setTimeoutTimer('嘉立创示例_单次', 200, (msg) => { received = msg; }, '延时任务完成');

_source.title: 设置单次定时器
_source.remarks.text.0: 如果遇到 ID 重复的定时器，则之前设置的定时器将被清除
_source.example.text.0: 1. 设置 200ms 后触发一次的定时器，并给回调传参
_source.example.text.1: 2. 等待定时器到期（单次定时器触发后自动结束，无需手动清理）
_source.params.args: 传给定时调用函数的参数

title: Set a timeout timer
remarks.text.0: If a timer with a duplicate ID is encountered, the previously set timer will be cleared
params.args: Arguments passed to the timer callback function
returns: Whether the timer was set successfully
